description: Use when the user asks who they really compete with, whether a competitor is gaining on them, or how their brand interest compares with rivals. Returns each brand's share of US Google searches among the brands named, the change in points against the year before, search growth and a volume band, ranked. Shares and bands only, never monthly volumes. Safe to cite: its controls are checked first, it states its limits, and every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. If a control fails it refuses and you are not charged. This tool charges nothing: it validates the request and returns a payment_url, the price and instructions. Pay by POSTing to payment_url over MPP (HTTP 402, a Stripe shared payment token from your wallet). Price: $0.05 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $0.50 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound. To have a sound result considered for publication on cultmath.com, add publish: true and question (what you were asked) to the POST body; CULT+MATH reviews every submission first.
